name: SHEENLAC Premium NC / PU Solvent Thinner for Automotive & Industrial Coatings
shortDescription: High-purity virgin solvent thinner for nitrocellulose lacquers, polyurethane coatings, and synthetic enamels, ensuring fast flash-off and blushing prevention.
overview: SHEENLAC Industrial Solvent Thinner is a high-purity blending solvent formulated with virgin aromatic hydrocarbons, esters, and ketones to provide optimal viscosity reduction for nitrocellulose (NC) lacquers, polyurethane (PU) wood finishes, and synthetic enamels. Unlike cheap recycled thinners contaminated with moisture that cause milkiness, pinholing, and orange peel, this premium thinner ensures controlled evaporation rates, exceptional clarity, and smooth atomization through pneumatic spray guns.
keyFeatures: Formulated from 100% virgin solvent stocks (zero moisture or recycled water contamination)
Controlled evaporation rate prevents blushing, cloudiness, and pinholing in high humidity
Produces exceptional atomization and smooth mirror-like film leveling during spray painting
Rapidly reduces viscosity of heavy primers, enamels, and 2-pack PU lacquers
High solvency power effectively dissolves and cleans cured paint from spray nozzles
Enhances gloss depth and clarity on transparent wood coatings and automotive lacquers
Supplied in sealed, leak-proof metal containers for safe industrial storage

specifications.Solvent Composition: Blend of Aromatic Hydrocarbons, Esters, and Ketones
specifications.Packaging Available: 1 Litre Can, 5 Litres Can, 20 Litres Drum, 200 Litres Barrel
specifications.Compatibility: NC Lacquers, Synthetic Enamels, PU Clear Coats, Melamine

applications: Thinning automotive refinish paints and industrial spray enamels
Diluting polyurethane and melamine transparent wood finishes
Flushing and cleaning pneumatic spray guns, paint pressure pots, and airless hoses
Degreasing metal surfaces prior to primer application
